_doc: The Truth Layer. evidence_level ladder: L0 opinion · L1 inferred (read code/git/web, not verified) · L2 code-verified · L3 runtime-verified · L4 production-verified. The cardinal rule: EVIDENCE CAPS CONFIDENCE — intrinsic_confidence = min(stated, ceiling(level)). So an L0 opinion can never be >0.40. Defaults are honest-by-construction (self-authored = L0/L1); overrides pin the high-stakes nodes against real evidence refs.

overrides.rationale: evaluate_gate is a shared deterministic verdict function and the known F1/F2/F1.b defects were fixed, but issue #3183 proved production enforcement has multiple direct callers and arch:verify possible_bypass_files=0 is only literal-smoke evidence, not callgraph or single-funnel proof. The sufficiency claim is therefore code-evidenced but not runtime/topology-proven.

route-level cross-account isolation is RUNTIME-proven by a live-DB test with a real signed bearer (L3 synthetic); the FULLY/complete (all-routes) + live-authed-UI-end-to-end claim remains the residual, so not L4.
1189 caps verified natively with real tests — the approach is code-evidenced; load-validation is absent.
pattern demonstrably works across rebuilds; the --check gate is real code.
pure opinion — 'enough' is unmeasured and donor-utilization shows clear holes.
graph-asserted leverage, demand-unproven — explicitly a bet, not evidence.
unwired; Postgres likely suffices at current scale — opinion.
calibration code exists (inference) but no live agents have earned trust — the model is unvalidated.
user chose feed-first 3× (a real datapoint), but there is no operator-at-scale validation.
verify-impl-evidence is real, but 'correct beyond the tests that exist' is inference — green != correct.
a user mandate (real) but the cost/benefit tradeoff is not empirically validated.
no load test; a throughput inference.
ERP code is real, but completeness/enforcement-by-convention is inference.

the round-trip + --check gates are real code; 'in practice' depends on running them.

Chronica has a shared money-verdict function and fixed the known F1/F2/F1.b defects, but current production code uses multiple direct evaluate_gate callers. The single-funnel/single-chokepoint topology is not proven by current tooling.
board-only/SoD proven in tests + a live run.
merkle chain has passing tests; no production.
tenancy code + a deployed smoke; UI end-to-end unproven.

survivable side-tables + reconcile-meta are working code.
